annotations.title: Plan a search from words (AI, returns no rows)

description: AI planner. Turns a request in words into a Sell to State search: scope, q (terms in the languages of the countries) and filters (country, lifecycle, date window, amounts). It returns no rows. count = the rows that `search` finds with exactly this scope, q and filters: call `search` with them unchanged to get the rows. If you add or change a filter, count does not apply. Use it when you need help to write q; if you can write q and the filters, call `search` directly. Example text: 'body-worn cameras for police in Kenya and South Africa, open tenders'. Returns {summary, scope, q, filters, url, count, notes}. When the text names nothing to search, returns {answer} only. Uses the daily AI search limit (3 a day for free accounts, 100 with a plan).
